## What it catches

`utils/`, `helpers/`, `misc/` files or folders, and mechanism names (`types`, `errors`, `validation`, `internal`, ...) in packages, in any letter case.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "no-ownerless-files",
  "severity": "error",
  "module": {
    "path": [
      "^(?:apps|packages)/(?:.*/)?(?:utils|helpers|misc)(?:[.][^/]*)?(?:/|$)",
      "^packages/[^/]+/(?:.*/)?(?:[tT][yY][pP][eE][sS]|[mM][oO][dD][eE][lL][sS]|[sS][cC][hH][eE][mM][aA][sS]|[dD][rR][aA][fF][tT][sS]|[eE][rR][rR][oO][rR][sS]|[vV][aA][lL][iI][dD][aA][tT][eE]|[vV][aA][lL][iI][dD][aA][tT][iI][oO][nN]|[cC][oO][nN][sS][tT][aA][nN][tT][sS]|[iI][nN][tT][eE][rR][fF][aA][cC][eE][sS]|[iI][nN][tT][eE][rR][nN][aA][lL])(?:[.][^/]*)?(?:/|$)"
    ],
    "numberOfDependentsLessThan": 100
  },
  "from": {}
}
```
